prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 30s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, top bun rose pink hair — wearing a skin-tight micro bodycon mini dress of opaque matte black 40-denier nylon with thin shoulder straps, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to just under her bust, the two sides of the nylon fully covering her bust, a wide horizontal band cut away across her ribs and stomach from just under her bust down to below her navel, the whole band bare, with two thin vertical straps of the nylon at the sides joining the bust section to the skirt, a plain ultra-high slit cut up the left side of the dress from the hem to her hip bone, the slit baring her whole left thigh and the side of her left hip, the hem ending just below her hip bones, a micro length hardly longer than a belt, her arms and legs bare, the nylon shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and very fine pale hair on her forearms catching the light. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin nylon molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the two thin side straps holding the bust section above the open band, the dress stretched taut over the curve of her hips and glutes, the open slit falling in a clean line, fine stretch lines and a soft matte sheen. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in glossy black lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and heavy gold rings on every finger. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips.

Background: a grand museum hall with a pale stone floor, tall columns, a wide staircase of standard steps and plain banners without any text, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
